policy: Mirror FOSS only when license allows. Proprietary firmware/apps = official manufacturer / store links only.
scope: RV · camper · Class A · light truck connectivity-first; light marine FOSS OK.

entries.title: VictronConnect

entries.title: weBoost support
entries.summary: Official support. UMRT: weBoost Authorized Installer. Outdoor RF required; AGC manages gain — no invent-from-zero; we do not tune gain like a volume knob.

entries.title: weBoost app
entries.summary: Install guidance, tower aiming, before/after readings. Complements Authorized Installer placement — does not create signal from zero RF.

entries.title: weBoost support & Wilson resources
entries.summary: weBoost support plus Wilson Amplifiers resources. Same honesty: outdoor RF / AGC / no invent-from-zero.

entries.title: SureCall support & manuals
entries.summary: Vehicle/building boosters — manufacturer only. Outdoor RF + antenna separation honesty still applies. No UMRT SureCall cert title.

entries.title: SureCall app
entries.summary: Antenna aiming / separation feedback on compatible boosters. Does not invent coverage from zero outdoor RF.

entries.title: Cel-Fi / Nextivity support
entries.summary: Nextivity Cel-Fi coverage systems. Official support only. Some models are operator-locked — confirm carrier fit before promising multi-carrier boost. No UMRT Cel-Fi cert title.

entries.title: CEL-FI WAVE app
entries.summary: Register, configure, monitor, update Cel-Fi (Bluetooth). Primary setup path — not a substitute for outdoor RF. Do not confuse with MyWAVE.

entries.title: CEL-FI MyWAVE app
entries.summary: Optional Follow-my-Phone utility for GO/ROAM Mobile Mode. Do not confuse with WAVE.

entries.title: KING Connect (legacy)
entries.summary: Do not sell new. Site returns 200 but is empty Shopify placeholder; deep support/manuals 404. Existing Extend → weBoost RV path. No KING cert title.

entries.title: Winegard support
entries.summary: RV antenna / ConnecT / ConnecT 5G — official Winegard only. ConnecT is a connectivity hub (Wi-Fi + cellular paths), not a weBoost-class RF amp; set expectations honestly.

entries.title: Winegard RV Halo app
entries.summary: Official app for Winegard ConnecT / Halo products (replaces discontinued ConnecTed). Setup, updates, manuals — not a cell-booster AGC tuner.

entries.title: Starlink app
entries.summary: Official Starlink app (obstruction / setup / account). Installs-only — no Starlink Certified title.

entries.title: GL.iNet firmware downloads
entries.summary: Travel / 4G-5G routers common on coaches — official firmware CDN + support. Link only (not a FOSS mirror of proprietary images).

entries.title: Teltonika Networks wiki

entries.title: Dometic mobile apps

entries.title: OpenWrt

entries.title: Starlink plans (Residential vs Roam)
entries.summary: Honesty for RV travel: Residential is fixed-address (no roam / no in-motion). Roam is the travel plan (pause/standby; in-motion in select areas). /rv redirects to Roam — not a separate SKU. Install capability only — never Starlink Certified.

entries.title: Starlink hardware specs (official PDFs)
entries.summary: Official specs hub + Mini / Flat High Performance / High Performance PDFs for power sizing honesty. Link only — we do not re-host binaries.

entries.title: Starlink bypass mode (third-party router)
entries.summary: Official bypass-mode guidance for Peplink / third-party routers. Pair with Peplink firmware for bonding and/or failover (SpeedFusion). No proprietary firmware hacks.

entries.title: Starlink accessories & shop
entries.summary: Official mounts, cables, and shop. Prefer Starlink accessories pages over third-party clones when advising customers.

entries.title: Dometic support

entries.title: Orion-class DC-DC (e.g. Orion-Tr Smart)
entries.summary: Orion-class DC-DC (e.g. Orion-Tr Smart — illustrative class example, not a must-buy SKU or partner badge) for lithium-safe chassis/alternator charging. Do not drop LiFePO4 onto unprotected alternators or dumb converters.
entries.honesty: Hard gate: chassis lithium needs proper DC-DC / alt protection.

entries.title: Lynx DC distribution
entries.summary: Lynx Distributor / DC bus family — fuse hierarchy starts at the Li bank (Class-T or manufacturer-required), then downstream ANL/MIDI/MEGA by ampacity.

entries.title: MK3-USB (VE.Bus interface)
entries.summary: Official MK3-USB interface for VE.Bus configure/update with Victron tools — download software from Victron only.

entries.title: Battery compatibility (LiFePO4)
entries.summary: Official Victron battery compatibility / lithium notes. Cold-corridor honesty: LiFePO4 typically refuses charge near/below freezing unless heated LiFePO4 / integrated heat / BMS charge-gate (generic — no house brand endorsement). Example only: many BMS inhibit ~0 °C/32 °F — confirm battery/BMS manual.
